title: DISPATCH
description: Work handed to an agent. Delivered as a file in workflow/dispatches/ (fleet: the worker's inbox; solo: alongside the plan). Human form: workflow/templates/DISPATCH.md. A dispatch missing ACCEPTANCE or FENCES is invalid -- the linter treats it as malformed.

filled.description: A required field must be present, non-empty, and not still hold a <template placeholder>.

OBJECT.description: The one thing being worked on -- file, feature, question.

EXACT_REF.description: Commit hash / artifact hash / version this work is against.

ACTION.description: What to do, in one sentence.

ACCEPTANCE.description: The command(s) or observable(s) that define done -- runnable, not vibes.

FENCES.description: What is out of bounds: files not to touch, decisions not to make, spend limits.

FORECAST.description: Predicted duration / tokens / attempts BEFORE work starts -- every dispatch is a bet; the receipt's ACTUAL grades it (Law 9, calibration flywheel).

NEXT_EVENT.description: What happens when done: who consumes the receipt, what it unblocks.
